services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: Thank you for your interest in booking a group visit to the GLBT Historical Society Museum! We offer discounted admission rates for groups of 10 or more visitors scheduled in advance, whether you are an informal group, nonprofit or corporate organization, or school. Guided tours of our museum are currently available for sponsors. Docent-led tours of the museum are temporarily suspended due to staffing constraints and program re-vamping, but will be available in the future.
